goal: Build a personal finance tracker in Python with multi-currency support, category filtering, and a CLI interface.
context: User is a developer comfortable with Python. Using Python 3.11, no frameworks, keeping it simple with a flat-file JSON database. Decided against SQLite to keep it beginner-friendly. Wants to eventually add a web UI but not yet.

Built simple CLI menu (add, view monthly summary, filter by category, exit)
Fixed off-by-one bug in December month filtering

next_steps: Wire up data.json loading on startup so data persists between runs

full_summary: The user is building a CLI-based personal finance tracker in Python. We designed a Transaction dataclass and implemented core CRUD operations, monthly filtering, and totals. A simple CLI menu was added. We also fixed a December month-filtering bug (was using <= 12 range instead of direct month comparison). The main remaining gaps are: data doesn't persist between runs, currency rates are hardcoded, and there's no error handling for file corruption.
